sample_unit: pregnant and postpartum women completing baseline visit

links.outcome: Identification of LVSD with AI-guided screening versus usual care in randomized trial
links.quote: Using the AI-enabled digital stethoscope, the primary study end point was met with detection of 24 out of 587 (4.1%) versus 12 out of 608 (2.0%) patients with LVSD (intervention versus control odds ratio 2.12, 95% CI 1.05-4.27; P = 0.032).

screen.reason: Pragmatic randomized clinical trial evaluating the clinical effectiveness of AI-guided screening (AI digital stethoscope and AI-ECG) compared to usual care for diagnosing left ventricular systolic dysfunction in obstetric patients.
